moves.name:
Massive Jaws
Liquidation
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s Attack is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Lowers the target’s Defense by 2 stat ranks. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

moves.name:
Kalos
Passion
moves.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Applies Kalos Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play.

moves.name:
Rushing Rapids
Aqua Jet
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 2. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 ranks. If the user’s Feraligatr has Mega Evolved, also increases this attack’s power by 50%.

moves.name:

Confidence!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks. Applies Kalos Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play.

moves.name:

Liquidation
moves.description: Become Mega Feraligatr until the end of battle. The more the user’s Attack is raised, the greater the power of this attack.

passives.name: Kalos Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.
